meal.title: What is a CPU?
meal.objective: Identify the CPU as the computer's brain

voice.script: What makes a computer think? The CPU, or central processing unit, is the part that carries out every instruction, just like a brain processes thoughts. Virtualization means the CPU can pretend to be many separate brains, each handling its own program. The CPU reads instructions from memory, does the work, and writes results back. This is why we say a CPU is the computer’s brain. Imagine the memory as a bookshelf where the CPU pulls the pages it needs to read.
